title: Scribe
subtitle: Talk. Tickets write themselves.
skipped: Not sent: that didn't sound like work, so it stayed on this device.
idle: Press the mic and start talking
idleNoMic: No speech recognition here. Type below instead, download a speech model in Settings (desktop app), or open wordsmith in Chrome, Edge or Safari.
typePlaceholder: Or type a thought and press Enter
transcriptEmpty: Your words show here as you speak. Each finished thought goes to your model right away, while you keep talking.
activityEmpty: Tickets appear here the moment they are written.
detected: Found a model server on this machine and picked {model}.
privacy: Your browser turns speech into text; Chrome, Edge and Safari send the audio to their maker's speech service to do it. The text then goes only to the model server above, and tickets sync to wordsmith like anything you type.

problems.mic-denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it for wordsmith (in your browser, or in your system's privacy settings for the app), then press the mic again.
problems.mic: Speech recognition stopped ({detail}). Press the mic to start again.
problems.model: Could not reach your model ({detail}). Your words are kept and will be sent on Retry.
problems.model-setup: No model server was found on this machine. Start Ollama or LM Studio, or set a server and model below, then Scribe can write tickets.
problems.timeout: Your model took too long to answer. Your words are kept and will be sent on Retry.
problems.cors: If the server is running, it may be refusing this site: see "Can't connect" under the model settings.
problems.speech: The speech model stopped ({detail}). Press the mic to start again.

privacyLocal: Speech is turned into text on this device by the model you downloaded; no audio leaves it. The text then goes only to the model server above, and tickets sync to wordsmith like anything you type.
cloudUsageHint: Your daily allowance resets at midnight UTC. A request usually costs 3 to 8 neurons.
cloudSignIn: Sign in to use wordsmith cloud.
cloudUnavailable: wordsmith cloud is not set up on this server.
keyPlaceholder: Only if the server needs one
privacyCloud: Your browser turns speech into text (Chrome, Edge and Safari use their maker's speech service for that). With wordsmith cloud the text then goes to Cloudflare Workers AI through wordsmith, and nowhere else (speech that doesn't sound like work stays here); tickets sync to wordsmith like anything you type.

help.title: Can't connect to a model on this computer?
help.intro: Your browser only lets a website talk to a model server on your computer if that server allows the site. Ollama allows only the sites listed in its OLLAMA_ORIGINS setting, so add this one and restart Ollama.
help.windows: Windows: run in PowerShell, then quit Ollama from the tray and open it again
help.mac: macOS: run in Terminal, then quit Ollama from the menu bar and open it again
help.linux: Linux: add this to the service, then restart it
help.keep: This replaces what OLLAMA_ORIGINS held before: keep any sites you had listed, separated by commas.
help.script: Or, from a copy of the wordsmith repo, one command sets up Ollama, a model and this setting:
help.chrome: Chrome and Edge may ask to let this site reach devices on your local network: allow it.
help.lmstudio: LM Studio: in the Developer tab, open Server Settings and turn on Enable CORS.
help.llamacpp: llama.cpp: llama-server answers any site unless started with its own --cors settings.
